name: kgsl_info
cmd: echo '--- kgsl devices ---'; ls /sys/class/kgsl/ 2>/dev/null; echo '--- gpu freq ---'; for f in /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/gpuclk /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/max_gpuclk /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/gpu_available_frequencies /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/gpu_busy_percentage /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/temp; do [ -f $f ] && { echo -n "$f="; cat $f 2>/dev/null; }; done
